summary: @servicetitan/link-item preinstall downloads Bun and executes an opaque 730KB bundle
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip, extracts the platform-specific Bun binary, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~730KB Bun-compiled bundle (header '// @bun @bun-cjs') with rotated identifiers and a large string-array cipher table, containing no readable logic. The package's advertised purpose is a React link-item UI component (dist/index.js, src/*.tsx), which requires no runtime code and does not need a second language runtime. The obfuscated payload is not listed in package.json 'files' and is unrelated to the component code. Installing the package on a default `npm install` fetches an alien runtime and runs opaque, publisher-mismatched code on the installer's machine during the preinstall lifecycle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
